## Description

Dark palette (canvas #0F1C2A, card #12202E, accents #2BB3A3/#6B9BFF/#A08CF0, red #F47A86, ok #4CC79C) and high-contrast theme (2 px borders, no tints, underlined links); user preference + OS setting; AI stays dashed; red/amber keep labels.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** All screens render correctly in dark and high-contrast (visual tests on core journeys).
- [ ] **AC2.** Contrast ratios meet AA in both themes (automated check).
- [ ] **AC3.** Theme preference persists per user.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
